title: いつか交わるその日まで！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This year's Japanese Derby is over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A new Derby champion has emerged, burning her name into the annals of history. Although the race turned up the heat for the whole generation…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan ended up injured after pushing themselves past their limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're both taking a break to recover, and it sounds like it will be a while before they're able to race again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: We should get going now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you for seeing us off. Yaeno, Bamboo, please take good care of yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We'll be counting down the seconds until you're fully recovered and back at the academy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you. We may not be able to race for a while, but I'm sure we'll be back in no time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Plus, we'll have to keep training a bit here and there to expedite our recovery. Which means we'll be counting on you a lot on our road to recovery!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's no problem! I'm sure we'll both be more than happy to help you with whatever you need!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I hope you have a safe trip to the hospital… I… I'm also looking forward to your return.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno! What're you making that face for?! You're gonna make them feel bad!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My apologies. That wasn't my intent.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If I'm honest, it's quite distressing that the two of you won't be racing, even if it's only temporarily.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O and Ardan will be back at the starting gate before you can blink!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Then we'll all be able to run together in another awesome race like the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I know that's how it'll go down, so I'm gonna keep putting my best foot forward on the track! You two can't give up either, got it?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Burn bright, Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan! Give it all you've got!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You're right. I'm sure one day…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: We'll be able to run in another race just as exciting as the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. As long as I have this dream in my heart, I know someday it will come true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your encouraging words, Bamboo. I swear to repay you for them on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …There they go.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must offer my thanks as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I appreciate what you said just now.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What did I do to deserve thanks?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I could have never lifted Chiyono O and Ardan's spirits the way you did.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll never be able to forget the sight of Chiyono O and Ardan pushing themselves past their limits during the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But when I think about those two being gone, it feels like a hole has suddenly opened up in my chest. It fills me with such… indescribable pain and loneliness…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, Yaeno…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yet you were able to cheer them on with your earnest words. It wasn't only Chiyono O and Ardan whose hearts you bolstered, but mine as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm going to do everything I can to improve myself so that I can be a worthy rival for them when they return.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And so that, one day, we can all run in a spectacular race together once more.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngggh…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: FRIENDSHIP RUUULES!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, my motivation's white-hot and burning through the roof!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You all blind me with your light, but I refuse to be outshone! I want to stand right there next to you as equals!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Let's set everything on fire together! Our souls, our races, our dreams, and our whole generation!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's turn everything into a fierce blaze!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (I've got my own dream and my own heights to reach! I'm gonna work just as hard as Yaeno and everyone else!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (I hope you're ready for me, Swan Stakes!)
